title: Give wages wings
tagline: The Unbanked pay Mom and Dad bills back in their home country, with Defi
description: Let's get the unbanked on-chain so their US Dollar earnings can pay mom and dad's bills back home. We will connect to the most popular payroll Earned Wage access companies who undocumented and unbanked workers are most likely to be paid by. We bring the advent of Stablecoins to move money 24/7 globally.
how_its_made: Using Replit and FernHQ we send USDC and PYSD to reduce the cost of moving traditional FIAT across borders. We utilize the APIs and Access keys available in the public domain of the lastest EWA On-chain employers. We tap into the payroll systems and connect the with reputable Stablecoin vendors such as Paypal and Circle
